why: Both carry so man zu ihm | ihm kommt across the break once, with no omission or addition on either side.
Both render an Titum | Titum und Timotheum once as Titus and Timothy with no duplication; the rest is equivalent.
Both render Camerario pro Chirothecis correctly; left keeps the catchword fragment Ca-, which is allowed but reads less smoothly across the break.

left_defects.translation: one patient of excuse | patient of excuse.

why: Both sides render the catchword patiens a second time after the break, leaving dangling fragments of equal weight.
Both handle the catchword An | An illis correctly and render the following questions equivalently.

right_defects.source: toritate Magistratus tam durè flagellas, disce, inquá, ipse non modo de nostris Magistratibus & Principibus bene sentire: sed etiam de iis, quæ in eorum actionibus non intelligis ... nequaquam temere iudicare.
right_defects.translation: (nothing; jumps from neglected authority— to But yet, so that everyone may understand)

why: Right drops the whole sentence that crosses the break (the rest of auctoritate Magistratus and the learn to think well of our Magistrates clause); left renders it in full.
